sloka: स रथेनाग्निवर्णेन बलवान् रावणात्मजः।इन्द्रजित् कवची धन्वी सध्वजः प्रत्यदृश्यत ।। ६.८७.८ ।।
transliteration: sa rathenāgnivarṇena balavān rāvaṇātmajaḥ।indrajit kavacī dhanvī sadhvajaḥ pratyadṛśyata ।। 6.87.8 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, who was endowed with mighty prowess, armed with shield and sword, appeared like glowing gold in the chariot decorated with a post.
